features.title: Live P&L & Budget vs Actual
features.body: Monitor high-value cost heads like materials, subcontractors, labour, and equipment across projects. Track WIP reports, spot budget deviations early, and control overruns with real-time expense tracking and variance analysis.

features.title: Approval Gates & Controls
features.body: Route payments and vouchers through configured approval rules before they post. SiteFlow enforces RBAC on financial actions so only the right roles can approve spend, and every transaction stays tied to its company and project.

personas.title: Developers & Contractors
personas.body: See project-wise profitability and committed cost in real time, with budget vs actual across every cost head.

personas.title: Infra & EPC Firms
personas.body: Track thousands of cost items across multi-year projects with complete financial visibility and variance analysis on long-duration work.

personas.title: Interior & Industrial Projects
personas.body: Keep tight control of smaller, faster projects with the same job-costing and cashbook discipline as large builds.

faqs.q: Does SiteFlow connect to accounting and compliance tools?
faqs.a: Yes. SiteFlow exports vendor bills, sales invoices, and payments to Tally Prime as importable voucher XML, pushes data to Zoho Books, and generates ZATCA e-invoices. Statutory reports (PF, ESI, BOCW cess, TDS, professional tax) are available through the statutory router.

faqs.q: How does SiteFlow keep financial data tenant-safe?
faqs.a: Every financial transaction carries a company_id and is gated by company and project membership checks, so one company can never read or write another's books.

faqs.q: Can I see profitability before a project closes?
faqs.a: Yes. Live P&L and budget vs actual update as costs are booked, so you see margin erosion while there is still time to act, not at year-end.

cta.heading: Ready to take control of your project cash flow?
cta.body: Bring budget, cashbook, and P&L into one real-time view. Track profitability by project and cost head with SiteFlow financial management.
